one_line: Portuguese admiral whose early 1500s voyages to India mixed oceanic daring with brutal terror in the Arabian Sea.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but solidly built, with the wiry toughness of a seasoned sailor and commander.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong nose, dark olive complexion from sun and sea, neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, deep-set intense brown eyes under slightly arched brows, default expression focused and severe with a hint of cold calculation.
appearance.hair: Thick wavy black hair, medium length just touching the collar, combed back from the forehead, topped with a dark crimson wool beret-style cap edged in dull gold embroidery and a small dark feather on the left side.
appearance.costume: A dark navy-blue wool doublet with padded shoulders and simple brass buttons, worn over a cream linen shirt whose modest collar and sleeves peek at the cuffs; a sleeveless black velvet jerkin cut slightly longer, trimmed with narrow dark red braid; around his waist a sturdy brown leather belt with a plain iron buckle and a small pouch; dark brown wool hose and black leather ankle boots with square toes suited to ship decks; over all, a heavy sea-worn dark brown cloak lined with muted burgundy, fastened at the right shoulder with a round brass brooch, the cloak’s hem and edges visibly salt-stained and wind-torn to keep him era-accurate yet modestly draped.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Portuguese naval cutlass with a brass cup-hilt, plain iron pommel, and weathered leather grip, sheathed in a dark brown scabbard that hangs from his belt at his left hip, often held in his right hand as a symbol of his hard-edged command.

ref_desc: Vasco da Gama is a mid-30s olive-skinned Portuguese admiral with wavy black hair, trimmed beard, crimson beret, navy doublet, black jerkin, brown cloak, hose and boots, carrying a brass-hilted cutlass, in a palette of navy, brown, black, cream and crimson.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style historical Portuguese admiral, mid-30s, olive complexion, oval face, strong nose, deep brown eyes, trimmed black beard and moustache, wavy black hair brushed back to the collar and topped with a dark crimson beret-style cap edged in dull gold embroidery and a small dark feather. He wears a dark navy-blue wool doublet with padded shoulders and simple brass buttons over a cream linen shirt, with a slightly longer sleeveless black velvet jerkin trimmed in narrow dark red braid, a brown leather belt with iron buckle and pouch, dark brown wool hose and black leather ankle boots with square toes, all covered by a heavy dark brown cloak lined in muted burgundy, fastened at the right shoulder with a round brass brooch and showing salt stains and frayed hems. At his left hip hangs a dark brown scabbard holding a slightly curved Portuguese naval cutlass with a brass cup-hilt and worn leather grip, which he lightly holds in his right hand. Use a color palette dominated by navy blue, dark brown, black, cream and crimson, and pose him in a firm, commanding stance that suggests both navigational skill and ruthless resolve at sea.
